name: Rezin
bio:
Rezin, king of Syria, was sent by the LORD against Judah in the days of Jotham, together with Pekah son of Remaliah (2 Kings 15:37).

## 📖 Core Story: Death at the Hand of Assyria

Rezin joined Pekah, king of Israel, in besieging Jerusalem, but they couldn't overcome Ahaz. Rezin did recover Elath for Syria, driving out its Jewish inhabitants. When Ahaz appealed to Tiglath-Pileser of Assyria for help, the Assyrian king attacked Damascus, captured it, deported its people, and killed Rezin, ending his reign (2 Kings 16:5-9).
